**Finding: missing — no insurance covenant (INSURANCE, preferred target).**

The MSA contains no insurance obligation anywhere: targeted searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate", and "policy" return nothing, and General Provisions (p0063–p0073) move from governing law through counterparts without any insurance term. No exhibit carrying insurance terms is incorporated. Yet Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and "collect[s], maintain[s], manage[s] and stor[es] ... visitor information (data)" (p0035) — an uninsured data-processing vendor is walk-away territory under the rule.

Cure: a single inserted subsection (j) after p0073 carrying only the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where Kubient processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer (drafted to reach every category, not named examples), statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No survival tail, expense, or procedural extras were added, and no neighbouring text was rewritten. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is flagged in the comment as the negotiating retreat.
